_comment: Deep narrative record template (extends corpus.template.json). Fill one object per narrative and save batches to data/raw/. Base fields are validated by scripts/01_build_corpus.py; the 'narrative' block and fieldwork extension are validated by scripts/04_qa_narratives.py. A record without a 'narrative' object counts as a base (non-deep) record. Remove all _comment fields before submitting.

texts.tradition: REQUIRED tradition slug registered in src/lib/colors.js TRADITIONS

source.url: REQUIRED working URL verified at collection time

sensitivity.note: REQUIRED when content is restricted; restricted=true blocks ingestion

passages.text: Verbatim public-domain excerpt 40-200 words, OR a condensed paraphrase that MUST carry the note field
passages.note: MANDATORY for paraphrase: 'Condensed paraphrase of X, ch. Y; not verbatim.'

texts.language: Original language of the primary source
texts.canonical_translation: Translation relied on for the narrative text (translator + year)

narrative.en: REQUIRED complete narrative summary, target 400-2500 words: beginning, middle, end; principal characters; key events; outcome; cultural/ritual function. QA flags <50 words as stub, 50-399 as below target.

variants.name: Variant name
variants.summary: One-paragraph summary of how this variant differs
variants.cross_ref: id of a linked record, or 'none'

primary_sources.citation: Edition/translator/year + book/verse/line/folio + manuscript siglum where known

texts.sensitivity_guidance: REQUIRED when sensitivity_flag != none: community protocol guidance; paraphrase vs verbatim policy

reconstructed_segments.restored_in: Critical edition or scholar who restored it (with year)
